summary: The file lookup returns contents of a file on the controller and doesn't support globbing (use fileglob).
questions: How do I read a local file's contents into a variable?
Can the file lookup read files on the managed host?
Can I use wildcards with the file lookup?

answer_card.title: file lookup
answer_card.answer_md: `lookup('ansible.builtin.file', '/path')` returns a file's contents from the **controller**. It doesn't support globbing; use the `fileglob` lookup for patterns.
